answer: The sparrow schedule is applied in orchard and fable publishes each instalment. An farming party thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 54% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4517 identities would post 1739 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
